text.tspan: Wage of craftsmen relative to that of laborers in England1220 to 2000
Craftsmen are skilled and specialised workers, for example, carpenters. Laborers are typically unskilled workers
who work in the building trade.
Data source: The Condition of the Working Class in England, 1209-2004, Clark (2005)
